post.description: Run a read-only, exact-device diagnostic pass.

get.description:
Public AI availability.

Never returns the API key (or any derivative of it). ``reachable`` is only
evaluated when ``probe=true`` so a page load never calls the external
model; otherwise it stays ``null`` ("not probed").

Return the masked effective AI configuration.

The API key is never present. ``api_key_configured`` is the only key-
derived boolean. Corrupted local settings degrade to defaults rather than
500.

put.description:
Save editable AI configuration + optional new API key. Body is never logged.

A missing or empty ``api_key`` field preserves the stored key; deletion
is a separate authenticated action (DELETE /ai/settings/api-key).

post.description:
Test the current or a temporary configuration. Temporary key is not saved.

The request body (which may carry a temporary ``api_key``) is never logged
and never persisted. The probe tries ``/models`` first, then a minimal
chat completion (max_tokens=1) for gateways that do not expose ``/models``.

delete.description: Delete the locally-saved API key only. An environment-variable key is untouched.

AISettingsResponse.title: AISettingsResponse
AISettingsResponse.description:
Masked effective AI settings returned by GET /ai/settings.

``api_key_configured`` is the *only* key-derived field; the raw key, its
length, or any derivative is never included.

AISettingsSaveRequest.title: AISettingsSaveRequest
AISettingsSaveRequest.description:
PUT /ai/settings — editable fields + optional write-only API key.

``api_key`` semantics:
  * omitted      -> the stored key is preserved
  * empty string -> the stored key is preserved (NOT a delete)
  * non-empty    -> replace the stored key (DPAPI)

AISettingsTestRequest.title: AISettingsTestRequest
AISettingsTestRequest.description:
POST /ai/settings/test — optional temporary config (never persisted).

A temporary ``api_key`` lives only in this request's memory: it is not
written to the store, cache, DB, report, or logs.

AISettingsTestResponse.title: AISettingsTestResponse
AISettingsTestResponse.description: Result of a connection test. No key, no host echo beyond the request.

AIStatusResponse.title: AIStatusResponse
AIStatusResponse.description: Public AI availability. Never exposes the API key or its length.

ConsentCheckpointState.title: ConsentCheckpointState
ConsentCheckpointState.description: Public, secret-free representation of a checkpoint.

TaskAIArtifactSummary.title: TaskAIArtifactSummary
TaskAIArtifactSummary.description:
Identifying summary of the regenerated AI section, returned by the
``regenerate`` route so the client can immediately poll the artifact
endpoints. Carries no secrets and no model text.
